meta.title: feat: update integration tests workflow with improved caching
meta.body_summary: Update integration tests workflow with pnpm caching using actions/cache@v4, --frozen-lockfile for deterministic installs, removed cleanup step, and simplified branch triggers.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added pnpm caching; maintainer wtfsayo tested and tweaked config; merged in ~45 min with no blocking review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 7343 changed lines across 60 files, this is a large change by absolute volume, but most churn (2641 lines in pnpm-lock.yaml and 661 lines in transferAction.ts) comes from merging develop branch and unrelated package updates; the core workflow caching change is only ~22 lines in integrationTests.yaml. This fits a CI performance improvement that merged after maintainer testing and tweaks, despite the noise from branch merges.

core_change_summary.description: In .github/workflows/integrationTests.yaml, added actions/cache@v4 step for pnpm store cache, updated install command to use --frozen-lockfile, removed a redundant cleanup step, and simplified branch trigger syntax.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The majority of changes come from merging the develop branch, which brought unrelated package updates and lockfile regeneration (2641 lines in pnpm-lock.yaml).
